snippet.title: Magenta Down - Official Reveal Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Magenta Down, a sci-fi atmospheric adventure game developed by 2 Ton Studios. Players will traverse a harsh, remote exoplanet to endure injury and radiation exposure with scarce supplies. Search for a way to save yourself and your crew in Magenta Down, launching on Xbox Series X|S and PC in 2027.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
